description: A metal dish rack sits on a green tablecloth with four upside-down plastic cups inside: blue, green, yellow, and red. The left hand reaches into the rack to grasp the blue cup, lifts it up, then lowers it over the green cup and continues stacking it onto the yellow and then the red cup, forming a nested stack in the left-hand object before lifting the full stack out of the rack and setting it down to the left.
